composition: The call card as a motion graphic rather than a dark box with a number in it (owner, 2026-10-14). A handset that rings on its own rhythm, signal arcs leaving it, and the number as the largest thing on the card. A page whose motion score has no ambient-field sets `still` and the card renders its settled frame: no ring, no tilt, waves shown at rest (portfolio hub, owner 2026-10-27).

source.selector: «این کارت خودش یک موشن گرافیک بشود»
